entwurf.thema: Slide software options listed on Wikipedia's presentation slide page, from LibreOffice Impress to PowerPoint

teile.name: Deadline
teile.text: One hour left, slides still blank. Which software won't betray you? One has a catch.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered late-night desk, one hand on his forehead, medium shot, warm lamp and cold cyan glow.

teile.name: Open alternative
teile.text: Under Production software, LibreOffice Impress is called a FOSS alternative.
teile.szene: Source card showing the Production software section of the Wikipedia Presentation slide page, with the LibreOffice Impress FOSS alternative line highlighted, close crop, clean lighting.

teile.name: Popular is not required
teile.text: PowerPoint is listed as currently the most popular slides presentation program. Popular, not compulsory.
teile.szene: Source card of the Wikipedia Production software passage stating PowerPoint is currently the most popular slides presentation program, highlighted, close crop, soft daylight.

teile.name: Live collaboration
teile.text: Google Slides was developed in 2007, and allows live collaboration. So what's the catch?
teile.szene: Source card of the Wikipedia passage on Google Slides stating it was developed in 2007 and the tool allows live collaboration, highlighted, close crop, neutral light.

teile.name: The catch
teile.text: Apple Keynote works on Macs and some other Apple devices. "Some" is the catch.
teile.szene: Source card of the Wikipedia passage stating Apple Keynote works on Macs and some other Apple devices, highlighted, close crop, cool light.

teile.name: Export to video
teile.text: PowerPoint allows users to export a presentation to video, .mp4 or .wmv. That blank hour now has a backup plan.
teile.szene: Source card of the Wikipedia Sharing websites section, highlighting the line that PowerPoint allows users to export a presentation to video (.mp4 or .wmv), close crop, clean light.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket leans back in his chair, relieved and smiling, closed laptop on the desk, medium shot, warm morning light.

entwurf.beschreibung: A quick look at slide software named on Wikipedia's presentation slide page: LibreOffice Impress, PowerPoint, Google Slides and Apple Keynote. Prices are not covered.
